description: c115 re-author: boot directly into Swarm-CPU via --launch-scenario swarm_cpu (skips Settings -> Debug -> Test Scenarios menu nav entirely), then cycle the bot ladder via action injection of ACTION_TESTSCEN_CYCLE_COUNT (focus-independent, bypasses SDL/ImGui focus gate). Verifies TESTSCEN.LAUNCH: Swarm-CPU, BENCHMARK.SWARM.CPU log emission, and bot-count ladder progression (4 -> 8 -> 16 -> 32 -> 48 -> 64 -> 128 -> 256). Surfaces B-307 (256-bot spawn-frame crash) if the ladder reaches it.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: --launch-scenario seeds testScenarioLaunch(SWARM_CPU) post-catalog-init. matchStart() routes through MP arena base:mp_felicity stagenum (initial count=4). FINDING: player pos is uninitialised at this point, so respawn_ring fails (spawned=0) and the match ends ~5s later into an endscreen_solo menu, which pushes imgui_menu IMC on top and suppresses ACTION_TESTSCEN_CYCLE_COUNT via gameplayInputSuppressed(). The cycle attempts below will fire harness-side but cycler_tick will not fire until the endscreen is dismissed AND a fresh match starts on a properly-positioned player.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_USE
input_sequence.comment: dismiss endscreen_solo via continue (may restart match)

input_sequence.name: ACTION_TESTSCEN_CYCLE_COUNT
input_sequence.comment: cycle 4 -> 8 (will succeed only if endscreen dismissed + gameplay context on top)
scripted exit; if B-307 was going to crash it would have done so well before this point
